verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents its own programmatic surfaces: a TypeScript plugin API whose Vault interface works with files and folders, an Obsidian URI protocol for actions such as opening or creating notes, and a headless Sync client for agents and automated workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows these reach parity with the UI. The URI protocol covers only certain actions, and the plugin API runs inside the app. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, an external API (e.g. REST) for driving the app from outside, and API coverage of features like Bases, Graph view, Publish and Canvas.
